title: Unvalidated External Image URLs from NFT Metadata
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium    **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In multiple components (`CollectionDetails.tsx`, `NftDetails.tsx`, etc.), NFT image URLs sourced from on-chain metadata or third-party APIs are passed directly into rendering components like `<NftThumbnail />` without validation or sanitization.
